title: Reynolds Number - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile with Tom Crawford of Oxford explains the Reynolds number, the second of three videos on Navier-Stokes and fluid flow, with demonstrations of laminar versus turbulent behavior.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible layperson's introduction to the Reynolds number and fluid dynamics scales.

quote.text: I think this is a good lay-person's introduction to basis of Kolmogorov's length scale, specifically the Reynold's number
